decision: Refine the approved Chapter 1 visual direction so no total panel quota or fixed panels-per-page rule applies. Permit situation-driven panel-count changes and controlled overlapping, inset, diagonal, foreground-break and bleed geometry when it strengthens the event and preserves explicit reading order, safe zones and continuity.
rationale: The user explicitly directed that the total number of panels may be broken depending on the situation and that panels may overlap when necessary, citing the supplied examples as the desired intense page-design standard. This records the principle without copying those examples or prematurely approving a storyboard or artwork.
